decisions.statement: A page is read from the newest commit that wrote the page.
A commit that removed the page is left out.
The page asked after is named by its path rather than found among every page.
A path git has no commit writing is answered as nothing.
A body that will not load is answered as nothing.
A subagent is answered only where the agent id the body states is the id asked for.

definition: what a subagent's page said before that page went, read out of the commit that wrote it
